Abstract.Name: SimpleNameSyntax
Abstract.Doc: An identifier used as an expression, with or without type arguments.

Node.Name: SimpleNameTypeSyntax
Node.Doc: A type name, optionally with type arguments: `Int`, `List<T>`.

Node.Name: QualifiedNameSyntax
Node.Doc: A dotted type name: `Sable.Collections.List<T>`.

Node.Name: TypeArgumentListSyntax
Node.Doc: A generic argument list: `<Int, String>`.

Node.Name: OptionalTypeSyntax
Node.Doc: An optional type: `T?`.

Node.Name: ImplicitlyUnwrappedTypeSyntax
Node.Doc: An implicitly unwrapped optional, for interop only: `T!`.

Node.Name: ReferenceTypeSyntax
Node.Doc: A reference type: `T&`, `T&<u32>`, `T&<u16 in pool>?`.

Node.Name: RelativeReferenceSpecSyntax
Node.Doc: The width and pool of a relative reference: `<u32 in pool>`.

Node.Name: FixedSizeArrayTypeSyntax
Node.Doc: `T[]` or `T[k]`: size fixed at construction, or at compile time.

Node.Name: InlineArrayTypeSyntax
Node.Doc: `T[..]` or `T[..k]`: inline capacity, resizable within it.

Node.Name: GrowArrayTypeSyntax
Node.Doc: `T[>..]` grow-only, or `T[>..<]` grow and shrink.

Node.Name: SliceTypeSyntax
Node.Doc: `T[:]`: a non-copying slice view.

Node.Name: TupleTypeSyntax
Node.Doc: `(A, B)` or `(label: A, b: B)`; also a function type's parameter list.

Node.Name: TupleTypeElementSyntax
Node.Doc: One element of a tuple type, with an optional label; as a function type's parameter, `inout` before its type.

Node.Name: FunctionTypeSyntax
Node.Doc: `(A, B) throws(E) -> C`, optionally `async`.

Node.Name: ThrowsSpecSyntax
Node.Doc: `throws`, `throws(E)` or `rethrows`.

Node.Name: OpaqueTypeSyntax
Node.Doc: `some P`: monomorphised, statically dispatched.

Node.Name: ExistentialTypeSyntax
Node.Doc: `any P`: boxed, dynamically dispatched through a witness table.

Node.Name: SuppressedTypeSyntax
Node.Doc: `~Copyable`: a constraint a generic parameter has unless it says otherwise, lifted.

Node.Name: AttributedTypeSyntax
Node.Doc: `@escaping () -> Int`: a parameter's type with an attribute on it.

Node.Name: RefTypeSyntax
Node.Doc: `ref T`: a borrowed reference whose root is inferred.

Node.Name: CompositionTypeSyntax
Node.Doc: `P & Q`: protocol composition.

Node.Name: UnionTypeSyntax
Node.Doc: `A | B`: a structural union.

Node.Name: SelfTypeSyntax
Node.Doc: `Self`: the conforming type inside a protocol or extension.

Node.Name: LiteralTypeSyntax
Node.Doc: `4` in `Buf<Int, 4>`: a value given to a value generic parameter.

Node.Name: LiteralExpressionSyntax
Node.Doc: A literal. Interpolated strings are a single token for now; their holes are available through SyntaxToken.Parts.

Node.Name: IdentifierNameSyntax
Node.Doc: A bare identifier used as an expression.

Node.Name: GenericNameSyntax
Node.Doc: An identifier with explicit type arguments: `max<Int>`.

Node.Name: MemberAccessExpressionSyntax
Node.Doc: `a.b` or `a?.b`; the operator token says which.

Node.Name: ImplicitMemberAccessExpressionSyntax
Node.Doc: `.Circle`: a member looked up in the contextual type.

Node.Name: InvocationExpressionSyntax
Node.Doc: `f(x)`, `f?(x)`, or `f(x) { ... }` with a trailing closure, and `onFail: { ... }` after it with more.

Node.Name: IfExpressionSyntax
Node.Doc: `if c { a } else { b }` where a value is wanted: each branch's last line is its value.

Node.Name: LabeledClosureSyntax
Node.Doc: `onFail: { ... }`: a trailing closure after the first, labelled for its parameter.

Node.Name: ArgumentListSyntax
Node.Doc: A parenthesised or bracketed argument list.

Node.Name: ArgumentSyntax
Node.Doc: One argument, with an optional label and an optional `&`, `out` or `move`.

Node.Name: PrefixUnaryExpressionSyntax
Node.Doc: `-x`, `!x`, `~x`, `&x`, `await x`, `move x`.

Node.Name: PostfixUnaryExpressionSyntax
Node.Doc: `x!`: force-unwrap.

Node.Name: TryExpressionSyntax
Node.Doc: `try e`, `try? e`, `try! e`, and the inline-recovery form `try e catch { ... }`.

Node.Name: RangeExpressionSyntax
Node.Doc: `a..<b`, `a...b`, and the partial forms `..<b` and `a...`.

Node.Name: CastExpressionSyntax
Node.Doc: `x as T`, `x as? T`, `x as! T`, `x unchecked as T`.

Node.Name: TypeTestExpressionSyntax
Node.Doc: `x is T`.

Node.Name: DictionaryExpressionSyntax
Node.Doc: `["a": 1]`, or `[:]` for the empty dictionary.

Node.Name: RecordExpressionSyntax
Node.Doc: `Point { x: 1, y: 2 }`.

Node.Name: FieldInitializerSyntax
Node.Doc: `x: 1`, or the shorthand `x`.

Node.Name: TypeExpressionSyntax
Node.Doc: A type written where an expression goes, which only `.self` may follow: `Token[>..].self`, `Int?.self`, `(Int) -> Bool.self`.

Node.Name: BuiltinExpressionSyntax
Node.Doc: A compiler builtin: `#file`, `#line`, `#column`, `#function`, `#module`.

Abstract.Name: ConditionSyntax
Abstract.Doc: One element of an `if`, `guard` or `while` condition list.

Node.Name: ClosureExpressionSyntax
Node.Doc: The arrow form: `(a, b) => a + b`, or `x => x * 2`.

Node.Name: ClosureSignatureSyntax
Node.Doc: An arrow closure's parameters, parenthesised or a single bare name.

Node.Name: ClosureParameterSyntax
Node.Doc: A closure's parameter: a name, and its type after a colon, `inout` before it when the closure changes it in place.

Node.Name: BraceClosureExpressionSyntax
Node.Doc: The brace form: `{ a, b in ... }`, or `{ $0.isActive }`.

Node.Name: ClosureHeaderSyntax
Node.Doc: `a, b -> T in` at the head of a brace closure; the parentheses are optional.

Node.Name: CaptureListSyntax
Node.Doc: `[weak self, count = localCount]`.

Node.Name: InterpolatedStringExpressionSyntax
Node.Doc: A string with `\(...)` holes, rebuilt from the literal token so that each hole is a real expression node.

Node.Name: InterpolatedTextSyntax
Node.Doc: A run of literal characters inside an interpolated string.

Node.Name: InterpolationSyntax
Node.Doc: One `\(expr)` hole, or `\(expr:spec)` with a format spec after the colon.

Node.Name: ImplicitParameterExpressionSyntax
Node.Doc: `$0`, `$1`: a positional closure parameter.

Node.Name: MatchExpressionSyntax
Node.Doc: `match e { case p => v ... }`. In statement position it is wrapped in an expression statement.

Node.Name: MatchArmSyntax
Node.Doc: `case p where c => body`, or `default => body`.

Node.Name: MatchCaseBlockSyntax
Node.Doc: `case p: statements`, the colon form of a match case.

Node.Name: BindingPatternSyntax
Node.Doc: `let x`, `var x`, or a bare `x`.

Node.Name: UnionCasePatternSyntax
Node.Doc: `.Circle(let r)`, `Shape.Rect(width: let w, _)`.

Node.Name: SubPatternSyntax
Node.Doc: One payload element of a union case pattern, with an optional label.

Node.Name: RecordPatternSyntax
Node.Doc: `Point { x: 0, y: let y }`, or `{ name, age }` when destructuring a known type.

Node.Name: ArrayPatternSyntax
Node.Doc: `[first, _, last]` or `[let head, ...let tail]`.

Node.Name: RestPatternSyntax
Node.Doc: `...` or `...let tail` inside an array pattern.

Node.Name: TypeTestPatternSyntax
Node.Doc: `is T`.

Node.Name: BindingTypeTestPatternSyntax
Node.Doc: `let s as String`.

Node.Name: OptionalPatternSyntax
Node.Doc: `let v?`: an optional that holds a value, which the pattern matches; `.Some(let v)`.

Node.Name: LocalDeclarationStatementSyntax
Node.Doc: `let x: Int = 1`, `var y = 2`, `using let f = ...`.

Node.Name: VariableDeclaratorSyntax
Node.Doc: The name, optional type annotation and optional initialiser of a binding.

Node.Name: ElseClauseSyntax
Node.Doc: `else { ... }` or `else if ...`.

Node.Name: OptionalBindingConditionSyntax
Node.Doc: `let user = findUser(id)`, or the shorthand `let self`.

Node.Name: CasePatternConditionSyntax
Node.Doc: `case .Circle(let r) = shape`.

Node.Name: SwitchStatementSyntax
Node.Doc: The C-shaped form with explicit `fallthrough`; it binds no patterns.

Node.Name: RegionStatementSyntax
Node.Doc: `region arena { ... }` or `region frame = pool { ... }`.

Node.Name: YieldStatementSyntax
Node.Doc: `yield value`: a generator's next element.

Node.Name: DeclarationStatementSyntax
Node.Doc: A declaration used as a statement: a nested function or a local type.

Node.Name: LabeledStatementSyntax
Node.Doc: `outer: for ... { ... }`.

Abstract.Name: DeclarationSyntax
Abstract.Doc: Any declaration: a type, a member, or a top-level item.

Node.Name: CompilationUnitSyntax
Node.Doc: One source file: a module declaration, imports, and declarations.

Node.Name: ImportDeclarationSyntax
Node.Doc: `import A.B`, `import A.B as C`, `import A.B.{ X, Y }`, `import A.B.{ * }`.

Node.Name: AttributeSyntax
Node.Doc: `@inline(always)`, `@reflectable`.

Node.Name: ParameterSyntax
Node.Doc: `from source: Point`, `_ item: T`, `inout v: Vec3`, `values: Int...`.

Node.Name: ReturnClauseSyntax
Node.Doc: `-> T` or `-> ref T`.

Node.Name: GenericParameterSyntax
Node.Doc: `T`, `out T`, `T: Comparable`, `T: P = Int`.

Node.Name: WhereConstraintSyntax
Node.Doc: `T: P` or `S.Element == T`.

Node.Name: WherePredicateSyntax
Node.Doc: `N > 0`: a const-generic predicate.

Node.Name: BaseTypeListSyntax
Node.Doc: `: Base, Protocol1, Protocol2`.

Node.Name: UnionDeclarationSyntax
Node.Doc: `union Shape { ... }`, or `union Node.. { ... }` for a variant-sized union.

Node.Name: FieldDeclarationSyntax
Node.Doc: A stored or computed member: `var x: Int`, `let y = 1`, `var z: Int { get }`, or the terse immutable form `x: F32` inside a type body.

Node.Name: AccessorSyntax
Node.Doc: `get`, `get => e`, `set { ... }`, `set(v) { ... }`, `willSet`, `didSet`.

Node.Name: ComptimeDeclarationSyntax
Node.Doc: A 'comptime' block among declarations: run while the program is compiled.

Node.Name: UnionCaseDeclarationSyntax
Node.Doc: Union cases may be separated by commas or by line breaks.

Node.Name: EnumCaseDeclarationSyntax
Node.Doc: Enum cases may be separated by commas or by line breaks.

Node.Name: IncompleteDeclarationSyntax
Node.Doc: Attributes and modifiers with no declaration after them; error recovery only.
